question: Simplify (5z - 7y)² + (7z + 5y)² - 49z²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the Brahmagupta−Fibonacci algebraic identity: (ax − by)² + (bx + ay)² = (a² + b²)(x² + y²)

For the given expression (5z − 7y)² + (7z + 5y)², substitute a = 5, b = 7, x = z, and y = y.

Sum = (5² + 7²)(z² + y²) = (25 + 49)(z² + y²) = 74(z² + y²)

Expression becomes: 74z² + 74y² − 49z²

Result = 25z² + 74y²

**∴ The correct answer is 25z² + 74y².**
